# Sebastien Vanblaere

> Digital artist, creative technologist, open-source library author, and educator based in Belgium.
> Tagline: "Neurodiverse lover of coffee, art and philosophy. Preferably in that order..."

Sebastien Vanblaere (also publishing under **prjcts** and **kunstmijnoren**) creates procedural and generative art, audiovisual installations, pen-plotter drawings, philosophical writings, open-source creative coding libraries for p5.js, Processing, and vanilla JavaScript, and educational courses on creative coding.

## Primary Websites & Artistic Identities

- [Sebastien Vanblaere — Hub](https://sebastienvanblaere.be/): Central portal connecting art projects, open-source libraries, services, and educational courses.
- [prjcts.be](https://prjcts.be/): Main digital & procedural art portfolio, projects, audiovisual works, writings, and archive (available in Dutch, English, and French).
- [kunstmijnoren.be](https://kunstmijnoren.be/): Philosophical and existential reflections, etchings, drawings, scans, and photography ("Foliominnend Herwaarderingsfonds - Kunst, mijn oren.").

## Open-Source Creative Coding Libraries

- [p5.waves](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.waves/): Wave-formula and oscillation library for p5.js (officially listed in the p5.js Libraries directory).
- [p5.waves_lab](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.waves_lab/): Interactive wave experiments and showcase for p5.waves.
- [p5.waves_snippets](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.waves_snippets/): Ready-to-use code snippets for p5.waves.
- [processing.waves](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/processing.waves/): Wave formulas and procedural oscillation library for Processing (listed in official Processing Contributions).
- [vanilla.waves](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/vanilla.waves/): Zero-dependency JavaScript wave library.
- [p5.gysin](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.gysin/): Permutation and generative text/pattern library for p5.js inspired by Brion Gysin (officially listed in the p5.js Libraries directory).
- [vanilla.penplotter](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/vanilla.penplotter/): Vanilla JavaScript toolkit for pen-plotter generative art and SVG path generation.
- [p5.penplotter](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/p5.penplotter/): p5.js library for plotting and vector path export.
- [blocks.system](https://seb-prjcts-be.github.io/blocks.system/): Modular grid and block composition library for generative design.

## Creative Tools & Services

- [p5.export](https://prjcts.be/services/p5.export/): High-resolution frame, video, and vector export utility for p5.js sketches.
- [SVG Converter](https://prjcts.be/services/svg/): Vector conversion utility for creative coding and pen plotters.

## Education & Courses

- [Creative Coding — p5.js](https://sebastienvanblaere.be/services/creative_coding_p5.js/): Comprehensive Dutch/English creative coding manual and course using p5.js.
- [Creative Coding — Three.js](https://sebastienvanblaere.be/services/creative_coding_three.js/): 3D creative coding course and interactive guide for Three.js.
- [p5.blocks (concept)](https://prjcts.be/services/p5.blocks/): Visual and conceptual block-based thinking for p5.js education.
- [Audiovisueel](https://sebastienvanblaere.be/services/audiovisueel/): Educational resources for audiovisual arts and photography.
